title: Hillingdon Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to emergency medical help points, urgent care, and local hazards in the London Borough of Hillingdon.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 first (or 112). Call 105 for power cuts and 0800 111 999 for gas leaks.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals
- Hillingdon Hospital (24/7 A&E): Pield Heath Road, Uxbridge, UB8 3NN. From Uxbridge station: ~25 min walk south along Hillingdon Road and Colham Green Road, or bus U1, U2, U3, U4, or U7 directly to hospital forecourt.
- St Mary's Hospital (Nearest Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, Paddington, W2 1NY. Take Elizabeth Line from West Drayton/Hayes & Harlington to Paddington.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Hillingdon Urgent Treatment Centre: Ground Floor, Hillingdon Hospital, Pield Heath Road, UB8 3NN. Next to the main emergency department.
- Mount Vernon Urgent Treatment Centre: Rickmansworth Road, Northwood, HA6 2RN. From Northwood station: ~20 min walk west along Green Lane and Rickmansworth Road, or bus 282, 331, or H11 directly into Mount Vernon grounds.

3. Local Environmental Hazards
- River Colne and Frays River: Flood risks across the western boundary, particularly around West Drayton, Cowley, and Uxbridge Moor.
- River Pinn: Flood plains running through Northwood, Ruislip, and Uxbridge north.
- Grand Union Canal: Localised overflowing and bank overflow risk through Hayes and Yiewsley during persistent downpours.

4. Essential Supplies
- Large supermarkets and dispensing pharmacies along Uxbridge High Street, Station Road (Hayes), and High Street (Ruislip) supply bottled water, basic provisions, and over-the-counter medicines.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
